name: ascenda-claude-code-hooks
description: Claude Code hooks adapter for Ascenda AI workload telemetry.

scripts.test:sample: npm run build && cat examples/sample-post-tool-use-edit.json | node dist/cli.js PostToolUse
scripts.test:compact: npm run build && cat examples/sample-pre-compact-auto.json | node dist/cli.js PreCompact
scripts.bundle: esbuild src/cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --banner:js="import { createRequire as __cr } from 'node:module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);" --outfile=dist/cli.js
